proposed_widenings.name: ignore_web_restrictions
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants deterministic immunity/traversal behavior for webs that is not modeled by resistance, condition immunity, speed grants, or any existing terrain-facing effect atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain.

notes: Authored a composite magic-item encoding for Poison Resistance, climb speed equal to walk speed, and a once-per-dawn Web cast with fixed DC 13 and enlarged area. Omitted Spider Walk from the mechanics because encoding it with existing atoms would be misleading.
